title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Ten map-ready Fairfield blocks and micro-districts, each anchored to a specific destination and one source-backed reason to go.

cards.entity_name: Post Road at the Fairfield University Store
cards.title: Start with the University Store
cards.subtitle: Post Road • 1499 Post Road
cards.notes: Take the town shuttle to the Post Road block at the Fairfield University Store; check the academic-year schedule before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A campus-linked downtown block with a clearly identified University Store stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield University identifies its University Bookstore as part of the Town Green stop on the off-campus town shuttle.
cards.access_notes: Town shuttle service operates during the academic year and pauses on specified breaks and holidays.

cards.title: Browse the Brick Walk Promenade
cards.subtitle: Brick Walk • Post Road downtown corridor
cards.notes: Step off at Town Green and follow the Brick Walk promenade; confirm individual shop access instead of assuming one shared schedule.
cards.short_summary: A named downtown promenade directly included in the University shuttle stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield University explicitly lists Brick Walk as part of the Town Green stop on its off-campus shuttle route.
cards.access_notes: Use the academic-year town shuttle or independent transportation; businesses maintain separate access policies.

cards.title: Pause at Sherman Green
cards.subtitle: Post Road • Roger Sherman Green block
cards.notes: Use Sherman Green as the landmark for this Post Road block, then check the town calendar before planning around any programmed activity.
cards.short_summary: A central green that serves as a documented downtown event venue.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield’s official tourism site identifies Sherman Green as a venue for vendors and live entertainment during the annual Sidewalk Sale and Street Fair.
cards.access_notes: The cited programming is event-specific; consult the current town listing for dates and conditions.

cards.title: Connect at Fairfield Station
cards.subtitle: Unquowa Road • Fairfield Station district
cards.notes: Use Fairfield Station as the anchor for this compact transit district; compare the shuttle timetable with your separate rail itinerary.
cards.short_summary: The downtown rail district has a direct University shuttle connection.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield University lists Fairfield Train Station as a regular destination on its off-campus town shuttle.
cards.access_notes: The University shuttle and Metro-North have separate schedules; rail travel requires its own fare.

cards.entity_name: Old Post Road at Fairfield Public Library
cards.title: Use the Main Library Block
cards.subtitle: Old Post Road • 1080 Old Post Road
cards.notes: Head to the Old Post Road library block for public resources; review card, event, and study-room rules before choosing a service.
cards.short_summary: A civic block anchored by Fairfield’s main public library.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield Public Library identifies its Main Library at 1080 Old Post Road and lists study rooms among its services.
cards.access_notes: Library hours, borrowing eligibility, event registration, and room-use rules vary by service.

cards.title: Follow the Commons Walking Tour
cards.subtitle: Town Green • Museum Commons historic campus
cards.notes: Begin beside Fairfield Museum and follow the interpretive signs around Museum Commons and Town Green at your own pace.
cards.short_summary: A historic civic micro-district with a published self-guided route.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield Museum provides a self-guided walking tour of Museum Commons and Town Green, with interpretive signs throughout the historic center.
cards.source_title: Commons & Town Green | Fairfield Museum and History Center
cards.access_notes: The outdoor route is self-guided; museum buildings and exhibitions follow their own posted access terms.

cards.title: Make the Museum the Beach Road Anchor
cards.subtitle: Beach Road • 370 Beach Road
cards.notes: Turn onto Beach Road and use Fairfield Museum as the block’s unmistakable anchor; verify museum admission and closures before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A culture-focused block anchored by Fairfield’s local history museum.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield Museum identifies its location at 370 Beach Road and offers exhibitions and programs there.
cards.source_title: Visit | Fairfield Museum and History Center
cards.access_notes: The museum closes on listed holidays; its Research Library requires an appointment and separate admission terms may apply.

cards.entity_name: Sanford Street at Fairfield Theatre Company
cards.title: Check the FTC Campus
cards.subtitle: Sanford Street • 70 Sanford Street
cards.notes: Anchor the Sanford Street arts block at FTC’s campus, then consult the specific event listing for age limits, tickets, and seating.
cards.short_summary: A named performance block housing several Fairfield Theatre Company venues.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield Theatre Company identifies its campus at 70 Sanford Street and lists StageOne, The Warehouse, The Lot, and The Gallery there.
cards.access_notes: Admission and age restrictions depend on the event; tickets should be obtained through the venue’s official channels.

cards.title: Walk the Birdcraft Trails
cards.subtitle: Unquowa Road • 314 Unquowa Road
cards.notes: Use Birdcraft as the Unquowa Road block’s anchor and arrive with time for the trails; observe posted sanctuary rules while exploring.
cards.short_summary: A nature-oriented block anchored by a historic songbird sanctuary.
cards.evidence_claim: The Connecticut Audubon Society locates Birdcraft Museum and Sanctuary at 314 Unquowa Road and states that its trails open year-round from dawn to dusk.
cards.source_title: Birdcraft Museum & Sanctuary | The Connecticut Audubon Society
cards.access_notes: Museum hours are narrower than trail access; follow posted sanctuary and seasonal conditions.

cards.entity_name: Fairfield Woods Road at the Branch Library
cards.title: Try the Branch Library Block
cards.subtitle: Fairfield Woods Road • 1147 Fairfield Woods Road
cards.notes: Navigate to the Fairfield Woods Road branch block, then check the live library calendar and service rules before settling in.
cards.short_summary: A residential corridor stop anchored by Fairfield’s branch library.
cards.evidence_claim: Fairfield Public Library identifies the Fairfield Woods Branch Library at 1147 Fairfield Woods Road.
cards.source_title: Fairfield Woods Branch Library – Fairfield Public Library
cards.access_notes: Confirm current building hours and any room, program, or library-card requirements on the library site.
